description: The chart illustrates the effect of various language models across different language families, comparing the performance of mBERT and XLM models with different training objectives. The horizontal axis represents the language family categories, listed in the order: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, and Uralic, while the vertical axis is labeled "effect" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, marked at intervals of 5 and 10. Each language family is associated with a group of six bars, representing the models mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2, colored in light blue, dark blue, light green, dark green, pink, and red, respectively. The bars within each group vary in height, with the tallest bars generally found in the IE-Indic category, where mBERT-R2 and XLM-R2 reach approximately 18 and 19, and mBERT-B2 and XLM-B2 reach around 25 and 22, respectively. Error bars are present above each bar, indicating the range of variation. The bars are grouped by language family, with no apparent sorting within the groups, and no bars are visually emphasized.
